name: Aya
source:
The ultimate protagonist?! Oh no...

Aya is awkward, and doesn't know how to hold a conversation, let alone make eye contact! Maybe transferring to this all-girls high school is finally a chance to get a fresh start and make some friends?

But all these girls keep saying they're in love with them! What is a socially anxious girl to do!?
